curve.formula: new = min(100, floor(L + a * max(0, L - L0) ** p + 0.5)), for content met after the Exp. Share

assumptions.exp_share_rule: participant: full Black 2 exp; every other party member: (base >> 1) then Black 2 level scaling with its own level
assumptions.doubles: treated as singles (one participant per opponent Pokemon)
assumptions.wild: expected exp over the slot rates, level uniform in [min, max]

key_battles.battle: Kyogre (Cave of Origin, caught: no exp)
